name: Call of Earth

angles.text: As a shaman, receiving your first totem begins your communion with the elemental forces. It gives you a physical focus for earth-aligned spells and rites.
As a Skyborne, you begin your return to the winds by mastering the earth and grounding yourself in its solid foundations.

faq.answer: Windshaper Boros, also called Boro, lives in Thendal Grove. An elder practitioner and crafter, he guides initiates in understanding the elemental spirits and shapes their focal totems from elemental gifts.
An earth spirit gives you the Rough Quartz as proof of your meeting and communion. Windshaper Boros uses it as the foundation and heart of your Earth Totem.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Rough Quartz?

faq.answer: An Earth Totem gives you a personal focus for communing with earth spirits and channeling earth-based spells. It marks you as an initiate and anchors you to the world's elemental foundations.
faq.q: Why is an Earth Totem necessary?

faq.answer: The winds are only one part of the world's elemental balance. Before seeking their songs, you study all four elements, beginning with the earth's stability, patience, and strength.
faq.q: Why must one commune with earth before speaking with the winds?

faq.answer: Thendal Grove is the sanctuary where Windshaper Boros tends to elemental matters and instructs novices beginning their shamanic journey.

The earth spirit teaches that even the smallest stone can endure after greater things crumble. It asks for patience, inner strength, and the pursuit of wisdom in exchange for mutual respect and harmony.
faq.q: What wisdom does the earth spirit impart?

sections.body: An earth spirit gives you a shard of Rough Quartz as proof of your communion. It sends you to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove with the shard. Even the smallest fragment can endure. The spirits grant favor and respect to those who show patience, resilience, and wisdom.
sections.title: The Earth's Gift

sections.body: Windshaper Boros sets the Rough Quartz at the heart of your Earth Totem. He reminds you that the elemental path has four parts. You may long to hear and sing the songs of the wind. Yet mastery begins with understanding all four forces, starting with the unyielding ground beneath your feet.
sections.title: The Four Elements and the Totem

summary: An earth spirit sends you to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove with a shard of Rough Quartz. There, the shard becomes the heart of your first Earth Totem and begins your study of the elemental forces.
